card.name: Space before a count of cases or items
card.fires_on: The space (or separator) right before a specific number that gives a count, such as cases, deaths, people or units built. It appears in study results and in fact tables.

modes.label: Study event counts
modes.description: Space before a number of cases or events in trial or surveillance results.

modes.label: Totals in descriptions
modes.description: Space or separator before a total count in encyclopedia-style text or tables.

card.writes: It favors exact-sized numbers like dozens, fifty, sixty and seventy and suppresses million and ten-thousand words.
card.plain: It fires just before a modest count, like the number of cases or deaths in a study, and pushes away huge-number words.
